card.name: Linking words in mood-change warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (in, or, of, from, about) right after phrases like 'unusual changes' or 'changes in mood', mostly in suicidality and behavior-change warnings.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words such as 'from' or 'of' after a comparison or timing phrase.
